## Endpoints

### Data Read (12)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve details for a specific Whitepages entry by ID.
- `GET /{id}/{id}` — Retrieve details for a Whitepages entry using two IDs.
- `GET /AdServer/js/user_sync.html` — Retrieve user synchronization script for ad serving.
- `GET /adx/user/sync` — Synchronize user data for ad exchange purposes.
- `GET /api/sync` — Synchronize data with the Whitepages API.
- `GET /dsp/api/sync/send` — Send synchronization data to the DSP (Demand-Side Platform).
- `GET /jwumXNuB/v1/` — Retrieve data from a specific endpoint (jwumXNuB/v1).
- `GET /sync/v1` — Synchronize data with the Whitepages API (v1).
- `GET /ups/{upId}/fed` — Retrieve federated data for a specific UPS ID.
- `GET /usersync/{usersyncId}` — Retrieve user synchronization status by ID.
- `GET /v1/api/sync/inmobi` — Synchronize data with InMobi via the API.
- `GET /v2/id` — Retrieve details for a specific Whitepages entry by ID (v2).

### Data Write (4)
- `POST /6/map` — Write/update map-related data for a Whitepages entry.
- `POST /e/dtb/bid` — Submit a bid through the DTB (Direct to Buyer) endpoint.
- `POST /encrypt` — Encrypt data for secure transmission.
- `POST /wa/` — Write/update data associated with a Whitepages entry.

### Config (1)
- `GET /cdn/prod/config` — Retrieve configuration settings for the Whitepages CDN.

### Core API (1)
- `POST /api/{apiId}` — Access core Whitepages API functionality.

```typescript
  try {

    console.log("Entry Details:", response.data);
    return response.data;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error retrieving entry details:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```

```typescript
    return null;
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Whitepages's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Whitepages data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.whitepages.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Whitepages frontend uses
